scope: Enforcement fixture: the same pair carries ENFORCEMENT_CONTEXT_FOR and VERSION_VARIANT_OF. Expected: graph validator PASS (the VV edge carries its justification marker), integrity validator FAIL on the hard pair-conflict rule.

edges.rationale: DIRECT_REFERENCE: 与下一条 VERSION_VARIANT_OF 构成同一 pair 的硬冲突，应被拒绝。
edges.limitations: 仅用于测试 pair 硬冲突。

edges.rationale: VERSION_JUSTIFICATION: 用于让本条自身通过归一化支撑检查，从而把失败隔离到 pair 硬冲突规则。
edges.limitations: INFERENCE_BOUNDARY: 仅用于测试；不表示任何版本关系。
